info.title: Saved Views
info.description: The Saved Views API provides a central place to store view information so it can be retrieved or shared across applications.

get.description:
---

Retrieves all saved view associated to a iTwin, iTwin/iModel combination or group, at least one parameter must be provided.

This operation supports pagination and will sort saved views by displayName.

As the view data can be quite large, this collection call will not contain the view data themselves. To retrieve the data, make a call to [Get saved view](../get-savedview)

Extension data is returned as a list of links to query further. If you want to obtain the full saved view data, including extension data, use the `Prefer` header with `return=representation`.

### Authentication

Requires `Authorization` header with valid Bearer token for scope `itwin-platform`.

For more documentation on authorization and how to get access token visit [OAUTH2 Authorization](https://developer.bentley.com/apis/overview/authorization/) page.

---

shared.description: Flag for whether or not element is shared

creationTime.description: ISO-8601 compliant time (UTC) the saved view was created.

lastModified.description: ISO-8601 compliant time (UTC) the saved view was last modified.

yaw.description: Yaw (rotation of x towards y) of the orientation, in degrees

pitch.description: Pitch (rotation that raises x towards z) of the orientation, in degrees

roll.description: Roll (rotation of y towards z) of the orientation, in degrees

lens.description: Angle of the camera lens, in degrees

focusDist.description: Focal distance of the lens, in meters

eye.description: Location of the eye of the camera. (Array of numbers representing x, y and z)

enabled.description: List of Ids that should be enabled/visible.

disabled.description: List of Ids that should be disabled/hidden.

distance.description: The plane's distance from the origin.

invisible.description: If a clip plane is marked invisible, it should never generate edges when clipping geometry in the view.

interior.description: Used by iTwin.Js to know if this clip plane was generated during the parsing of other concave clip primitive that became two convex clip planes with an `interior` edge. Interior planes should not generate edges when clipping geometry in the view.

invisible.description: `true` if the primitive is a hole.

mask.description: `true` if this shape is a mask.

noConstructions.description: If true, don't show construction class.

noDimensions.description: If true, don't show dimension class.

noFill.description: If true, don't show filled regions.

clipVolume.description: If true, use the view's clipping volume. Has no effect on other types of clips like ModelClipGroups.

hiddenLineMaterialColors.description: If true, use hidden line material colors.

monochrome.description: If true, show view with monochrome settings.

invisible.description: Whether the subcategory is invisible or not.

weight.description: The line width in pixels. Must be a value between [1,32].

transparency.description: Transparency. Must be a value in the range [0,1]. 0.0 means fully opaque, and 1.0 means fully transparent.

transparencyFill.description: Fill transparency. Must be a value in the range [0,1]. 0.0 means fully opaque, and 1.0 means fully transparent.

subCategory.description: The Id of the SubCategory whose appearance is to be overridden.

providerName.description: Identifies the provider currently only CesiumWorldTerrain is supported.

exaggeration.description: A value greater than one will cause terrain height to be exaggerated/scaled.false (or 1.0) indicate no exaggeration.

applyLighting.description: Applying lighting can help to visualize subtle terrain variation.

heightOrigin.description: Origin value - height of the IModel origin at the project center as defined by heightOriginMode.

heightOriginMode.description: Determines how/if the heightOrigin is applied to the terrain height.

mode.description: Controls how the mask geometry is collected.

modelIds.description: Compressed Id set containing the model Ids.

subCategoryOrElementIds.description: Compressed Id set containing the sub category or element Ids.

priority.description: The priority of the planar clip mask.

transparency.description: The transparency of the planar clip mask. Between 0 (complete masking) and 1 (no masking).

invert.description: A value of true indicates that the mask should be inverted and only content within the mask should be displayed.

groundBias.description: The elevation of the map in meters relative the WGS84 ellipsoid.

transparency.description: A transparency value from 0.0 (fully opaque) to 1.0 (fully transparent) to apply to map graphics when drawing, or false to indicate the transparency should not be overridden.

useDepthBuffer.description: If set to true, the map tiles will be rendered with depth, allowing them to obscure other geometry. Otherwise, they are always rendered behind all other geometry.

applyTerrain.description: If true, terrain heights will be applied to the map; otherwise the map will be rendered as a plane.

nonLocatable.description: If true, the map will be treated as non-locatable - i.e., tools will not interact with it. This is particularly useful when the map is transparent - it allows the user to select elements that are behind the map.

provider.description: The provider that supplies the access to reality data source for displaying the reality model.

format.description: The format used by the provider to store the reality data.

id.description: The reality data id that identify a reality data for the provider.

iTwinId.description: The context id that was used when reality data was attached - if none provided, current session iTwinId will be used.

inside.description: Describes how a SpatialClassifier affects the display of classified geometry - that is, geometry intersecting the classifier.

outside.description: Describes how a SpatialClassifier affects the display of unclassified geometry - that is, geometry not intersecting the classifier.

isVolumeClassifier.description: True for volume classification; false for planar classification.

modelId.description: The Id of the GeometricModel whose geometry is used to produce the classifier.

expand.description: A distance in meters by which to expand the classifier geometry. For example, if line strings are used to represent streets, you might expand them to the average width of a street.

name.description: A user-friendly name, useful for identifying individual classifiers within a SpatialClassifiers.

isActive.description: Records whether this is the active classifier.

weight.description: The line weight in pixels as an integer in [1, 31]

transparency.description: The transparency in the range [0.0, 1.0] where 0 indicates fully opaque and 1 indicates fully transparent.

linePixels.description: The pixel pattern used to draw lines.

ignoresMaterial.description: If true, ignore the RenderMaterial associated with surfaces.

nonLocatable.description: If true, the associated Feature will not be drawn when using Viewport.readPixels.

emphasized.description: If true, the associated Feature will be emphasized. Emphasized features are rendered using the Hilite.Settings defined by Viewport.emphasisSettings

tilesetUrl.description: The URL that supplies the 3d tiles for displaying the reality model.

name.description: An optional, user-friendly name for the reality model suitable for display in a user interface.

description.description: An optional, user-friendly description of the reality model suitable for display in a user interface.

backgroundBase.description: The settings for the base layer.

weight.description: The line weight in pixels as an integer in [1, 31]

transparency.description: The transparency in the range [0.0, 1.0] where 0 indicates fully opaque and 1 indicates fully transparent.

linePixels.description: The pixel pattern used to draw lines.

emphasized.description: If true, the associated Feature will be emphasized. Emphasized features are rendered using the Hilite.Settings defined by Viewport.emphasisSettings

modelId.description: The Id of the model whose appearance is to be overridden.

renderMode.description: The basic rendering mode applied to the view. This modulates the behavior of some of the other flags.

dimensions.description: Whether to display geometry of class GeometryClass.Dimension.

patterns.description: Whether to display geometry of class GeometryClass.Pattern.

weights.description: Whether to allow lines and edges to draw with width greater than one pixel.

styles.description: Whether LinePixels are allowed to apply patterns to lines and edges. If false, they all draw as solid lines.

transparency.description: Whether element transparency is applied. If false, transparent geometry is drawn opaque.

fill.description: In RenderMode.Wireframe only, whether to display the interiors of planar regions with FillFlags.ByView.

textures.description: In RenderMode.SmoothShade, whether to apply RenderTextures to surfaces.

materials.description: In RenderMode.SmoothShade, whether to apply RenderMaterial]s to surfaces.

acsTriad.description: Whether to display a graphical representation of the view's AuxCoordSystem.

visibleEdges.description: In RenderMode.SmoothShade, whether to display the edges of surfaces.

hiddenEdges.description: In any mode except RenderMode.Wireframe, whether to display the edges of surfaces occluded by other geometry. This has no effect unless visibleEdges is also true.

shadows.description: In RenderMode.SmoothShade, whether to display solar shadows. This has no effect unless lighting is also true.

clipVolume.description: Whether to apply the view's clip volume to the geometry in the scene.

constructions.description: Whether to display geometry of class GeometryClass.Construction.

monochrome.description: Whether to produce a monochrome image.

backgroundMap.description: Whether to display background map imagery.

ambientOcclusion.description: In RenderMode.SmoothShade, whether to apply AmbientOcclusion.

wiremesh.description: If true, overlay surfaces with wiremesh to reveal their triangulation.

lighting.description: In RenderMode.SmoothShade, whether to apply lighting to surfaces.

pattern.description: If defined, the pixel pattern used to draw the edges. If undefined, edges are drawn using the element's line pattern.

width.description: If defined, the width of the edges in pixels. If undefined (or 0), edges are drawn using the element's line width. Should be an integer between [1,32]

transparencyThreshold.description: A value in the range [0.0, 1.0] specifying a threshold below which transparent surfaces should not be drawn. A value of 0.0 indicates any surface that is not 100% opaque should not be drawn. A value of 0.25 indicates any surface that is less than 25% opaque should not be drawn. A value of 1.0 indicates that all surfaces should be drawn regardless of transparency.

width.description: Number of pixels to be considered intersecting the clip plane, default 1.

produceCutGeometry.description: If `true`, geometry will be produced at the clip planes in a 3d view. - Solids (closed volumes) will produce facets on the clip planes. - Other surfaces will produce line strings representing the edges of the surface at the clip planes.

colorizeIntersection.description: If 'true', intersection of geometry and clip planes will be colorized.

invert.description: A value of true indicates that the mask should be inverted and only content within the mask should be displayed.

display.description: Whether the ground plane should be displayed.

elevation.description: The Z height at which to draw the ground plane.

front.description: JSON representation of the front image used by a SkyCube. Can be an image URL or the Id of a texture element.

back.description: JSON representation of the back image used by a SkyCube. Can be an image URL or the Id of a texture element.

top.description: JSON representation of the top image used by a SkyCube. Can be an image URL or the Id of a texture element.

bottom.description: JSON representation of the bottom image used by a SkyCube. Can be an image URL or the Id of a texture element.

right.description: JSON representation of the right image used by a SkyCube. Can be an image URL or the Id of a texture element.

left.description: JSON representation of the left image used by a SkyCube. Can be an image URL or the Id of a texture element.

texture.description: The image to map to the interior of the sphere.

display.description: Whether or not the skybox should be displayed

twoColor.description: For a SkyGradient, if true, a 2-color gradient skybox is used instead of a 4-color.

skyExponent.description: For a 4-color SkyGradient, controls speed of change from sky color to zenith color; otherwise unused.

groundExponent.description: For a 4-color SkyGradient, controls speed of change from ground color to nadir color; otherwise unused.

bias.description: If defined, represents an angle in degrees. If the dot product between the normal of the sample and the vector to the camera is less than this value, sampling stops in the current direction. This is used to remove shadows from near planar edges.

zLengthCap.description: If defined, if the distance in linear depth from the current sample to first sample is greater than this value, sampling stops in the current direction. The full range of linear depth is 0 to 1.

maxDistance.description: If defined, the maximum distance from the camera's near plane in meters at which ambient occlusion will be applied.

intensity.description: If defined, raise the final ambient occlusion to the power of this value. Larger values make the ambient shadows darker.

texelStepSize.description: If defined, indicates the distance to step toward the next texel sample in the current direction.

blurDelta.description: If defined, blurDelta is used to compute the weight of a Gaussian filter. The equation is exp((-0.5 * blurDelta * blurDelta) / (blurSigma * blurSigma)).

blurSigma.description: If defined, blurSigma is used to compute the weight of a Gaussian filter. The equation is exp((-0.5 * blurDelta * blurDelta) / (blurSigma * blurSigma)).

blurTexelStepSize.description: If defined, blurTexelStepSize indicates the distance to the next texel for blurring.

direction.description: Direction of the light in world coordinates.

alwaysEnabled.description: If true, the light will be applied even when shadows are turned off for the view. If false, a roughly overhead light of the same intensity oriented in view space will be used instead.

timePoint.description: If defined, the time in UNIX milliseconds from which direction was calculated.

specularIntensity.description: Specular intensity applied to all lights.

numCels.description: Applies a cel-shaded effect. If greater than zero, specifies the number of cels.

monochromeMode.description: The style in which the monochrome color is applied. Can be 1 (Scaled) or 0 (Flat).

renderTimeline.description: The id of a Render Timeline element containing a schedule script that can be used to animate the view.
